method: Sim-core naming by evidence (sim-universe pass). Anchored on CET univUpdate 0x54C3F0: walked its decompile line-by-line against HomeworldSDL/src/Game/UnivUpdate.c univUpdate (:7292) to name every per-tick callee by call slot, gating globals (universe struct offsets from CET asserts, woodpecker tweak globals) and argument shape; then aligned each source file's HW1 function order with the binary address order (MSVC6 keeps per-file source order) using those anchors, confirming each candidate from its decompile (list heads used, flags, strings, param counts, callers/callees). Command layer: clWrap* (CET) -> SP cl* / MP clSend* pairs, clProcess switch cases -> process*ToDo. Cross-checked against other passes' proposals (core/ships/missions/hw1-match) to avoid conflicts. Cataclysm-only functions are skipped unless behaviour was clear. Creation/death pass: univCreateShip helpers (bindings, trails, navlights, modules), gun fire drivers (gunShootGunsAt*), bullet/resource free paths and clamp updates named from decompile + HW1 order; several HW1 helpers (univUpdateAllPosVelMinorObjs/Missiles/Derelicts/Effects, univPausedUpdateAllPosVelShips, univDeleteDeadResources body) are inlined into univUpdate and have no entry.
